An approximate model for simulation, scaled from reference distances at MTOW, sea level, ISA. Aircraft weights, reference distances and speeds are rounded public figures, so it is not official aircraft data, so compare with the EFB or FMC of the aircraft you fly. About Pranala ATLAS

Pranala ATLAS (Aircraft Takeoff Limit Analysis System) is a flight simulator takeoff performance calculation tool. It provides aircraft performance estimates based on aircraft configuration, weight, runway conditions, and weather data.

Designed for flight simulation enthusiasts, ATLAS supports multiple aircraft types and engine configurations.

These are the Terms of Usage for Pranala ATLAS.

Responsibility

This application is designed exclusively for flight simulation purposes. All performance calculations and recommendations are estimates and must not be used for real-world flight operations.

Users are responsible for ensuring that aircraft configurations, runway information, and weather data are accurate and up to date. Always refer to the relevant simulator aircraft documentation.
